title: SnurfTech's Rocket Launcher
description: This mod adds a rocket launcher to Minecraft 1.21.8.
body:
This mod was made with MCreator. It adds a rocket launcher to Minecraft 1.21.8. Items included in the mod:
| Name | Use | Crafting recipe / description of crafting recipe | Item texture / description of item texture |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Rocket Launcher | Launches an explosive rocket at whatever target you are currently looking at | ![One piston in the middle of the crafting table with a redstone block below, a stone button in the bottom left corner, and iron in all remaining slots except for the top center slot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12d470270a5d05fe9cacf7bd87d807003cedcd7d.png) | ![A grey tube with blue, red, green, and black on it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3b2572a8d06d0395d61a74ed431894648410b71.png) |
| Rocket | The actual rocket that is required to be in your inventory when using the rocket launcher, assuming you're not in creative mode | ![One tnt in the middle of the crafting table with a firework rocket below](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b77887c106868c9e2378848c2ec277fadee558b.png) | ![A blue tube](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92931d8f88ee94b59e2aa99a3ae1442885b75fe2.png) |
